Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a property tax exemption for certain land zoned or designated for agricultural use.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a property tax exemption for certain land zonedor designated for agricultural use; adding a new section to chapter84.36 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If the water right for the use of water for agricultural purposeson real property that is zoned or designated for agricultural use by alocal government is found to be relinquished under chapter 90.14,90.03, or 90.44 RCW, or is judicially found to be abandoned, the realproperty is exempt from taxation as long as it is zoned or designatedfor agricultural use by a local government.
This act applies to taxes levied forcollection in 2005 and thereafter.
